paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Legal Assistant position at Extract via OpenClaw. My background in international law, combined with my experience in legal research, contract drafting, and event coordination, makes me an ideal candidate for this role.

During my language internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy, I gained valuable exposure to Finnish legal practices and procedures. This experience allowed me to develop a strong working proficiency in Finnish, which will be invaluable in navigating the Finnish legal landscape as your Legal Assistant.

In addition to my legal expertise, I have proven event coordination skills from my time at International House Oulu. Coordinating community events with an average of 25 international participants each taught me effective logistics management and stakeholder liaison.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my diverse skill set to Extract via OpenClaw's Legal and Compliance team. I believe that my unique blend of legal knowledge, language skills, and event coordination experience will make a significant contribution to your organization.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.
